meta.name: python-sdk
meta.description: Python SDK for inference.sh - run AI apps, build agents, and integrate with 250+ models. Package: inferencesh (pip install inferencesh). Supports sync/async, streaming, file uploads. Build agents with template or ad-hoc patterns, tool builder API, skills, and human approval. Use for: Python integration, AI apps, agent development, RAG pipelines, automation. Triggers: python sdk, inferencesh, pip install, python api, python client, async inference, python agent, tool builder python, programmatic ai, python integration, sdk python

copy.tagline: 用Python调用250+AI模型构建应用与Agent
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用Python快速集成AI推理能力到自己的应用或Agent中。
copy.tagline_en: Build AI apps and agents with Python using 250+ models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate AI inference into your Python apps or agents.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以使用 Python 代码调用 inference.sh 平台上的 250 多个 AI 模型，运行 AI 应用、构建智能体，并支持文件上传、流式输出和异步操作。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Python SDK”、“inferencesh”、“pip install”等关键词，或要求用 Python 集成 AI 应用、开发智能体时触发。

say.text: 用 Python 运行 flux-1-dev 生成一张日落图片。
帮我创建一个智能体，使用 Claude Sonnet 4 并添加一个计算工具。
用 Python 上传图片并让 AI 分析内容。
say.note: Claude 会使用文件上传功能并调用图像分析应用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Python code to call 250+ AI models on inference.sh, run AI apps, build agents, and support file uploads, streaming, and async operations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like 'Python SDK', 'inferencesh', 'pip install', or asks for Python integration, AI app development, or agent building.

say_en.text: Run flux-1-dev in Python to generate a sunset image.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and execute Python code, returning the image.

say_en.text: Create an agent using Claude Sonnet 4 with a calculator tool.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Agent SDK to create an ad-hoc agent.

say_en.text: Upload an image via Python and have AI analyze it.
say_en.note: Claude will use file upload and call an image analysis app.
